Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  August 21, 2024

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on August 21, 2024.
Commissioner Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m., followed by the flag salute.

Ashley Ferrette announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1, Commissioner Olivia Alvitre -
  District 2, Commissioner Phyllis Battle ‐ District 3, Commissioner Jacques Lesure -
  Commissioner at Large

  Absent: Commissioner Vicki Perryman-Banks - District 4

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Thomas Uwal  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Ashley Ferrette  Staff Assistant

MINUTES. It was moved by Commissioner Metcalf and seconded by Commissioner Alvitre
that the minutes for the Arts Commission Meeting held on April 17, 2024, May 15, 2024,
and June 19, 2024, be approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:

Ayes:  Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, Battle, Banks, and Lesure
Noes:  None

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

SPECIAL SPEAKER. Rasta Asaru with The Creative House reported that six utility boxes
were recently vandalized; the graffiti on the utility boxes has since been removed and
sprayed with a particular type of spray to help preserve and protect the murals on the
utility boxes. Mr. Asaru announced the possibility of another 16 utility boxes being
wrapped. The Creative House is creating an art crawl with 7 to 9 businesses. It may be a
one-day event or possibly a one-week event, details to come at the next Arts Commission
meeting. The next art gallery event will be on September 22, where attendees will be able
to create a live sculpture and take it home. Mr. Asaru is also expecting to partner with the
Senior Center on future classes.

  1
   Arts Commission

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  a. Intuit Dome Public Art Program opened last month featuring the talented artists
  who displayed their artwork and shared their stories with the public. All of the Arts
  Commissioners and Public Officials were present at the opening ceremony. It was
  a memorable event for the art community.
  b. Michael Massenburg, one of Inglewood's legend artists, artwork was featured at
  the Intuit Dome public art opening ceremony. Michael Massenburg's artwork
  represents the multicultural and diverse population of Los Angeles. It was good to
  see him recognized for his great work.
  c. The Inglewood Open Studios Art Walk program will take place on November 9 and
  10, 2024. The City will assist the event by providing transportation and sponsoring
  the printing and installation of street banners for the art walk. We look forward to
  the annual event.
  d. The City Manager will attend the next Arts Commission meeting.

PUBLIC REMARKS. Jorge Gomez, a member of the Board of Inglewood Open Studios, held
an event in 2023 called The Curated Art Experience. He is looking to expand the event to
make it a block party type of event and include more local artists.

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Arts Commission Meeting: September 18, 2024 at 6:30 p.m.

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Lesure declared the
meeting adjourned at 7:11 p.m.
